correctness.rationale: For binary circular w length n, the full cyclic contiguous-window weight histogram H_w(k,j) has complement-row identity H_w(n-k,M-j)=H_w(k,j), so short rows k<=floor(n/2) plus total weight suffice. Exact exhaustive enumeration of all 2^n words, one minimal dihedral representative per orbit, computes each deck by two independent direct/rolling methods and groups every bracelet. Recomputed n12 224 bracelets/223 decks with one complement collision, n14 687/686 one complement collision, and n15 1224/1220 with four two-element fibers none equivalent by global bit swap, as source six pairs. This proves finite classification n<=15 when full exhaustive code is understood. For each length-15 collision pair u,v of equal weight six, periodic powers satisfy H_{u^m}(k,j)=m H_u(r,j-q*6) for k=15q+r and remain inequivalent as bracelets even after bit exchange, providing all multiples of 15. Finite exhaustion is exact for n<=15; arbitrary multiples follow from repetition identity.
